summary: Overdue female hiker separated from her partner near Zapata Falls; encountered a bear, was forced into the backcountry and became disoriented; built a shelter and survived the night; found ~11am by AVSAR and Fremont SAR K9 teams, uninjured
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR + Fremont SAR, CCSAR South, South Fork Fire Rescue, REACH Air Medical, CPW drone pilot
notes: approx; Fremont post dated Aug 15, 2024; activation Monday night Aug 12, found Tuesday Aug 13; Fremont SAR deployed 2 K9 teams + 2 flankers at 6am Monte Vista Journal adds: lost hiker had a close (~7 ft) encounter with a non-aggressive black bear, then hiked uphill off-trail and took refuge in an abandoned cabin ~2 miles up the South Zapata Lake Trail; Reach 29 helo spotted her Tuesday morning, AVSAR ground crews walked her out. Conejos County Citizen sister-paper copy (opened 2026-09-12, John Waters byline): Alamosa County Sheriff Robert Jackson confirms she was reported overdue ~9:30 a.m. Monday; searchers included AVSAR, Saguache County searchers, drones, and a Reach 29 helo; 22 YOF walked out with AVSAR ground crews and was transported by ground ambulance to San Luis Valley Health in Alamosa. | Advnture narrative (opened): out-of-state diabetic woman, phone and insulin pump batteries depleted; AVSAR says she brought 50 glucose pills and was down to her last two; divers deployed to the falls, a drone pilot spotted her red hoodie at 11 a.m., rescue dog made first contact; told rescuers she was charged/chased a short distance by a large black bear ~2 m away, then fled in panic uphill into the wilderness; sunburn and dehydration only, walked out. avsar.us missions index corroborates the 2024-08-12 missing/overdue call at Zapata Falls (hiker separated from partner); incident resolved 2024-08-13 — run 578 | run 833: AVSAR mission post merged (parent-opened, full-string absence verified)
